certificate.quotient: C4 x C4 x C2 x C2

conclusion: The three-case C4-projection classification enumerates every one of the 5,276 subgroups of C4 x C2^5 exactly once. Of them 2,925 have a nonzero commutator radical, while every one of the 2,351 faithful kernels has a saved and verified eight-clique. Thus this quotient has no exact-center case with clique number at most seven.
